description: The south corner of the tenth floor, over the street and the porte-cochère: oak, stone, a platform bed, a galley kitchen and two walls of glass. Ten floors is high enough that the traffic is a light show and not a noise. Leave north to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Residence 10-H
